'''Gamblor''', also known as '''Gamblor the Terrible''', was a fictional character who appeared in the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] ''[[Juo Deltar Faces Gamblor the Terrible]]''. He was a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Actor/Legends|played]] by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Unidentified Hutt actor|actor]].
